post_actions.failed.defaultMessage: {action, select, favourite {お気に入り} boost {ブースト} bookmark {ブックマーク} other {リアクション}}を完了できませんでした。
post_actions.failed.description: The notice at the bottom of the page when the reader's favourite, boost, bookmark or emoji reaction on a post (set or taken back) got no answer from the server (the network), beside Try again. The post shows again what it showed before. action is which of them.

post_actions.retry.description: The action of the notice of a failed favourite, boost, bookmark or emoji reaction: it sends the same change again.
